plugin.name: Inline_Image_Transcript_Test
plugin.author: MUSHclient contributors
plugin.purpose: Verify inline-image transcript and link behavior against a local fixture

muclient.script:
local seen_marker, checked = false, false local image_callbacks, image_triggers = 0, 0 local marker_time = 0 local enabled = false local deletion_request, deletion_called, deletion_result local fixture_ports = { ['Inline images - MXP test'] = 18766, ['Inline images - Pueblo test'] = 18767, } local output = GetPluginInfo(GetPluginID(), 6) .. '.results.txt' local function record(message) local f = assert(io.open(output, 'a')) f:write(message, '\n'); f:close() end function OnPluginInstall() local expected_port = fixture_ports[WorldName()] if not expected_port or GetAlphaOption('site') ~= '127.0.0.1' or GetOption('port') ~= expected_port then return end enabled = true local f = assert(io.open(output, 'w')); f:close() assert(AddTriggerEx('image_guard', '^\\[https?://.*\\]$', '', 41, -1, 0, '', 'ImageTrigger', 12, 100) == 0) record('START transcript test') end function ImageTrigger() image_triggers = image_triggers + 1 end function OnPluginLineReceived(line) if not enabled then return true end if line:match('^%[https?://') then image_callbacks = image_callbacks + 1 end if line:find('INLINE_SUITE_END', 1, true) then seen_marker = true; marker_time = os.time() end return true end local function action_at(line, expected) for style = 1, GetLineInfo(line, 11) do if GetStyleInfo(line, style, 5) == expected then return true end end return false end local function check(condition, message) record((condition and 'PASS ' or 'FAIL ') .. message) if not condition then error(message) end end function RunDeleteChecks() if not enabled or not deletion_request or deletion_request <= 0 then return end deletion_called = true deletion_result = DeleteLines(deletion_request) end function OnPluginTick() if not enabled or not seen_marker or checked or os.time() - marker_time < 4 then return end local images, after, text_link, image_tail = {}, nil, nil, nil for line = 1, GetLinesInBufferCount() do if GetLineInfo(line, 14) then if GetLineInfo(line, 18) == 0 then return end images[#images+1] = line end local text = GetLineInfo(line, 1) if text:find('AFTER_IMAGES', 1, true) then after = line end if text:find('Clickable text', 1, true) then text_link = line end if text:find('Image link tail', 1, true) then image_tail = line end end checked = true local ok, err = pcall(function() check(#images == 2, 'two image tags create exactly two transcript entries') check(image_callbacks == 0, 'image entries do not call received-line plugins') check(image_triggers == 0, 'image entries do not fire text triggers') for _, line in ipairs(images) do check(GetLineInfo(line, 18) == 1, 'image completed successfully') check(GetLineInfo(line, 16) == 640 and GetLineInfo(line, 17) == 240, 'image preserves intrinsic dimensions') check(GetLineInfo(line, 20) > 100, 'image occupies a variable-height transcript block') check(GetLineInfo(line+1, 19) == GetLineInfo(line, 19) + GetLineInfo(line, 20), 'following entry starts at image bottom') end check(after and after > images[2], 'text after images stays in stream order') check(text_link and action_at(text_link, 'text-clicked'), 'text command link retains its action') check(action_at(images[2], 'image-clicked'), 'image retains its enclosing command link') check(image_tail and action_at(image_tail, 'image-clicked'), 'enclosing command link resumes on text after image') check(after and not action_at(after, 'image-clicked'), 'image command link ends after its closing tag') local before = GetInfo(296) SetScroll(0, true) check(GetInfo(296) == 0, 'scroll-to-start uses pixel layout') SetScroll(-1, true) check(GetInfo(296) >= 0, 'scroll-to-bottom accepts image transcript')
-- Fill until there is room to scroll even in a large desktop window. local filler = 0 repeat for i = 1, 100 do filler = filler + 1 Note(string.format('INLINE_SCROLL_FILLER_%03d', filler)) end SetScroll(-1, true) until GetInfo(296) > 240 or filler >= 1000 local bottom = GetInfo(296) Pause(true) SetScroll(120, true) local scrolled_up = GetInfo(296) check(scrolled_up > 0 and scrolled_up < bottom, 'fixture transcript has a measurable scrolled-up position') Note('INLINE_SCROLL_APPEND_PROBE') local after_append = GetInfo(296) record(string.format('SCROLL append before=%d after=%d bottom=%d paused=true', scrolled_up, after_append, bottom)) check(after_append == scrolled_up, 'appending text while paused and scrolled up preserves the pixel position')
Pause(false) SetScroll(-1, true) local count_before_delete = GetLinesInBufferCount() local blank_tail = GetLineInfo(count_before_delete, 1) == '' local lines_to_delete = count_before_delete - images[2] + 1 if blank_tail then lines_to_delete = lines_to_delete - 1 end deletion_request, deletion_called, deletion_result = lines_to_delete, false, nil local previous_prefix = GetAlphaOption('script_prefix') check(SetAlphaOption('script_prefix', '/') == 0, 'fixture enables its command-script prefix') local command_status = Execute(string.format( '/CallPlugin("%s", "RunDeleteChecks", "")', GetPluginID())) SetAlphaOption('script_prefix', previous_prefix) check(command_status == 0 and deletion_called, 'tail deletion runs in the supported command-script context') local count_after_delete = GetLinesInBufferCount() local remaining_images, image_indices = 0, {} for line = 1, count_after_delete do if GetLineInfo(line, 14) then remaining_images = remaining_images + 1 image_indices[#image_indices+1] = line end end record(string.format('DELETE before=%d blank_tail=%s requested=%d return=%s after=%d original_images=%d,%d remaining=%d positions=%s', count_before_delete, tostring(blank_tail), lines_to_delete, tostring(deletion_result), count_after_delete, images[1], images[2], remaining_images, table.concat(image_indices, ','))) check(remaining_images == 1 and GetLineInfo(images[1], 14), 'deleting the tail removes the second image and retains the first') check(not GetLineInfo(images[2], 14), 'deleted image index no longer exposes image metadata')
DeleteOutput() check(GetLinesInBufferCount() == 1 and not GetLineInfo(1, 14), 'clearing the buffer releases all image entries') check(GetInfo(296) == 0, 'clearing the buffer resets the pixel scroll position') Note('INLINE_AFTER_CLEAR_PROBE') local found_after_clear = false for line = 1, GetLinesInBufferCount() do if GetLineInfo(line, 1):find('INLINE_AFTER_CLEAR_PROBE', 1, true) then found_after_clear = true end end check(found_after_clear, 'text appends after clearing the image transcript') record('PASS transcript checks completed') end) Pause(false) if not ok then record('ERROR ' .. tostring(err)) end end
